products.title: Heritage Classic Bifold Leather Wallet
products.description: Precision handcrafted from top-grain oil-pullup leather. Features dual currency bill compartments, 8 card slots, and hand-burnished edges.
products.shortDescription: Classic 8-card bifold wallet in full-grain pull-up leather.
products.careInstructions: Wipe with soft cotton cloth. Apply leather cream every 6 months.

products.title: Executive Trifold Leather Wallet
products.description: A spacious trifold silhouette featuring 12 credit card pockets, clear ID window, and hidden security slots.
products.shortDescription: Spacious 12-slot trifold wallet with transparent ID window.
products.careInstructions: Keep dry and away from prolonged direct heat.

products.title: Minimalist Front-Pocket Slim Wallet
products.description: Designed for front-pocket carry with ultra-thin profile, center cash stash pocket, and 6 quick-draw card sleeves.
products.shortDescription: Ultra-thin front pocket wallet with center cash pocket.
products.careInstructions: Buff gently with clean micro-fiber cloth.

products.title: Continental Long Zip-Around Leather Wallet
products.description: Full-length zip-around travel wallet accommodating unbent currency notes, smartphone, checkbook, and 12 cards.
products.shortDescription: Long travel zip wallet for cash, cards, and smartphone.
products.careInstructions: Lubricate zipper teeth with beeswax occasionally.

products.title: Artisan Formal Stitched Leather Belt (35mm)
products.description: Cut from continuous full-grain bridle bend leather with feather-edge tapering, tone-on-tone edge stitching, and solid zinc-alloy buckle.
products.shortDescription: Formal 35mm dress belt in full-grain bridle leather.
products.careInstructions: Hang straight when not in use. Wipe clean with damp cloth.

products.title: Reversible Dual-Tone Leather Belt (Black / Brown)
products.description: Two versatile looks in one belt with an Italian twist-reversing buckle mechanism. Premium smooth black on one side and warm cognac brown on the other.
products.shortDescription: 2-in-1 reversible belt with twist-lock mechanism.
products.careInstructions: Avoid over-flexing at buckle rotation point.

products.title: Heavy-Duty Casual Jeans Leather Belt (40mm)
products.description: Thick single-strip vegetable tanned buffalo leather belt with antiqued brass roller buckle. Rugged character that patinas richly over time.
products.shortDescription: 40mm wide casual belt for denim and chinos.
products.careInstructions: Condition annually with mink oil or neatsfoot oil.

products.title: Executive Ambassador Leather Briefcase
products.description: Hand-tailored executive briefcase featuring triple gusset compartments, keyed push-lock flap, dedicated laptop sleeve, and trolley luggage strap.
products.shortDescription: Triple-compartment executive leather briefcase with brass lock.
products.hardware: Custom Cast Solid Brass Lock & D-Rings
products.careInstructions: Store in breathable dust bag provided.

products.title: Heritage Leather Duffle Holdall (45L)
products.description: An airline carry-on approved weekend duffel bag crafted from heavy-gauge oil pull-up leather. Features bottom brass protective feet and side shoe tunnel.
products.shortDescription: 45-liter carry-on weekend travel duffel with shoe compartment.
products.hardware: Oversized Solid Brass Two-Way YKK Zipper
products.careInstructions: Wipe exterior with leather lotion.

products.title: The Multan Grace Structured Leather Tote
products.description: Graceful everyday shoulder tote crafted from Italian-tanned milled calfskin. Reinforced base keeps the silhouette standing proudly.
products.shortDescription: Elegant structured leather tote with magnetic center bridge.
products.careInstructions: Protect from cosmetic oil stains.

products.title: Classic Saddle Flap Crossbody Handbag
products.description: Timeless equestrian saddle bag silhouette with curved contouring, magnetic buckle flap, and adjustable strap.
products.shortDescription: Equestrian saddle silhouette crossbody in smooth veg-tan.
products.careInstructions: Buff scratches with clean fingers or neutral balm.

products.title: The Metropolitan Padded 15.6" Laptop Bag
products.description: Slimline professional laptop briefcase fitted with high-density EVA shock absorbing foam walls and organizational organizer.
products.shortDescription: Slim 15.6" laptop briefcase with shock-absorbing foam.
products.careInstructions: Keep away from sharp objects.

products.title: 14" Ultra-Slim Leather Laptop Folio Sleeve
products.description: Enveloping sleeve tailored for 13" and 14" ultrabooks. Soft micro-suede interior prevents scratching while magnetic snap keeps it closed.
products.shortDescription: Minimalist envelope sleeve for 13"-14" laptops.
products.careInstructions: Natural scuffs can be rubbed out with thumb friction.

products.title: The Multan Artisan Leather Messenger Satchel
products.description: Rugged yet refined leather postman bag with dual front buckle quick-release push snaps, wide cotton-canvas webbing shoulder strap, and pen organizer.
products.shortDescription: Classic field satchel with push-snap buckle straps.
products.careInstructions: Condition with saddle soap or leather oil.

products.title: Overnight Leather Weekender Duffel (38L)
products.description: Engineered for 2-3 day business trips. Features full U-shaped opening for easy packing, passport slot, and heavy leather grab handles.
products.shortDescription: 38-liter overnight leather travel bag with U-shape zipper.
products.careInstructions: Store stuffed with tissue paper to preserve shape.

products.title: Handcrafted Leather Dopp Kit Toiletry Washbag
products.description: Spill-resistant nylon lined dopp kit crafted from water-repellent oiled leather. Dual zipper flap reveals wide open toiletry access.
products.shortDescription: Water-resistant lined leather shaving and toiletry kit.
products.careInstructions: Wipe inner lining with soapy damp cloth.

products.title: Executive Leather Valet Tray / Catchall
products.description: Corner brass snap valet tray that packs completely flat for travel. Ideal for holding keys, watch, cufflinks, and smartphone.
products.shortDescription: Corner snap valet tray for desk, nightstand, and travel.
products.dimensions: Flat: 22 cm x 22 cm | Snapped: 17 cm x 17 cm x 4 cm
features: Solid brass snaps in all 4 corners
products.careInstructions: Wipe with dry microfiber cloth.

products.title: Handmade Leather Triple Watch Travel Roll
products.description: Protective cylindrical case with sliding watch cushions separated by rigid leather dividers. Protects 3 timepieces during transit.
products.shortDescription: Cylindrical 3-slot watch travel case with removable cushions.
features: Rigid partition walls prevent watches touching
Flat base rests securely on table
products.careInstructions: Keep in dry environment.

products.title: Ultra-Slim Dual-Sided Leather Card Holder
products.description: Features 3 card slots on each side plus a central top-load pocket for folded bank notes. Ultra-compact everyday carry companion.
products.shortDescription: 6-slot card holder with center folded cash slip.
products.careInstructions: Do not overstuff beyond 8 cards to maintain shape.

products.title: Gusseted Business Card Dispenser Case
products.description: Expanding accordion gusset holds up to 35 standard business cards crisp and uncreased. Magnetic closure keeps it clean.
products.shortDescription: Expanding business card case holding up to 35 cards.
products.careInstructions: Keep dry.

products.title: Luxury International Leather Passport Wallet
products.description: Designed for international flyers. Securely holds standard passport, boarding pass fold, 4 credit cards, SIM card slot, and mini travel pen.
products.shortDescription: All-in-one travel passport wallet with boarding pass pocket.
products.careInstructions: Condition every 6 months.

products.title: Handcrafted 6-Hook Folded Leather Key Case
products.description: Compact folded case with 6 solid steel spring hooks and double snap flap. Prevents key scratches inside your pocket or leather bags.
products.shortDescription: Folded 6-hook key case with dual snap closures.
features: Back stash slot for cash or parking ticket
products.careInstructions: Wipe clean.

products.title: The Gentleman Executive Leather Gift Set
products.description: A curated 3-piece presentation box containing a matching Classic Bifold Wallet, Formal Stitched Belt (adjustable), and Leather Key Fob in a foil-stamped keepsake wooden box.
products.shortDescription: 3-Piece curated gift set: Wallet + Belt + Key Holder in luxury box.
products.dimensions: Box: 28 cm x 20 cm x 6 cm
products.careInstructions: Individual care guidelines included inside.

products.title: A4 Executive Leather Conference Padfolio
products.description: Designed for boardroom executives and conference delegates. Houses an A4 writing notepad, business cards, pen loop, and tablet document sleeve.
products.shortDescription: Executive A4 conference padfolio with pen loop & card slots.
features: Pen loop and 4 business card slots
products.careInstructions: Wipe with dry cotton cloth.
